remarks: Fresh, stylish, and full of potential! Welcome to this beautifully refreshed two-bedroom, 1.5 bath condo located in a meticulously maintained complex in the highly sought-after Belltown neighborhood. Freshly painted throughout and featuring newly refinished hardwood floors. This inviting home provides the perfect canvas to bring your personal style to life. The thoughtfully designed layout offers comfortable living spaces, abundant natural light, and endless possibilities to customize and make it your own. Ideally situated just minutes from shopping, dining, parks, and public transportation. You will enjoy the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and community. Whether you're a first-time home buyer, looking to downsize, or searching for a smart investment, this home presents an exceptional opportunity in a most desirable location. Move right in, add your personal touches, and create the home you've been dreaming of!
